A1.justification: Both PDFs describe U4D. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, references, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite reflow and added appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original U4D generation, temporal consistency, downstream segmentation, calibration, and ablation results in Tables 1–8, with additional qualitative results in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds KITTI-360 benchmarking and uncertainty-region ablations in Tables 9–11.

M1.justification: The two-stage diffusion pipeline, entropy-based region selection, MoST architecture, and training objectives remain unchanged. Corrections to mask notation and branch dimensions clarify the existing description; the additional segmentor experiments test component choices without establishing a redesigned method.

E1.justification: Section 7.1 adds training and evaluation on KITTI-360, extending the represented driving data beyond nuScenes and SemanticKITTI. This is an additional dataset within the existing LiDAR generation domain; the original tasks and future-frame examples remain.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1–8 is retained. The new KITTI-360 comparison reuses LiDARGen and R2DM. Table 11 evaluates segmentors as interchangeable U4D components, rather than adding competing generation methods.

E3.justification: New ablations vary score-based selection versus top-10/15/20/25% selection and the uncertainty segmentor. KITTI-360 uses the SemanticKITTI training configuration. Equation 18 also changes the stated rotation-error calculation by adding a transpose; unchanged temporal scores do not establish that evaluation was rerun.

E4.justification: Tables 10–11 substantially extend validation of the central uncertainty prior by testing two previously unexamined dependencies: retained-region proportion and segmentation backbone. They compare score-based selection with several top-K proportions and RangeNet++ with FRNet, Cylinder3D, and SPVCNN. Existing selection-strategy, fusion, activation, and efficiency analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experimental results. The added tables retain single-score reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 9–11 add substantial benchmark and sensitivity findings. On KITTI-360, U4D reports FRD/FPD of 142.53/5.94 versus R2DM's 153.73/6.24. Score-based selection yields FRD 531.65 versus 223.96 for top-20% selection, and alternative segmentors show metric tradeoffs. Tables 1–8 retain their numerical results; these additions are new conditions, not improved scores on the original settings.

T1.justification: Equation 18 changes the rotation comparison from multiplying predicted and ground-truth rotations directly to multiplying by the ground-truth transpose. This corrects the mathematical definition of rotation error. No new theoretical results, assumptions, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: uncertainty-aware LiDAR generation, a two-stage hard-to-easy pipeline, and adaptive spatial-temporal fusion. The new appendix experiments support these existing claims.

C2.justification: Section 7 adds explanations linking poor score-based selection to variable region sizes and training difficulty, and excessive retained points to weaker guidance. It also interprets the segmentor ablation as evidence of reduced backbone dependence. The existing rare-event, computational-cost, and generation-horizon limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 documents that KITTI-360 inherits the SemanticKITTI training configuration and specifies the new ablation proportions and segmentor choices. Existing preprocessing, architecture details, training budgets, hardware, sampling steps, and resource-access information are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations including KITTI-360, CLIP2Scene, xMUDA, Robo3D, and additional perception and pretraining literature. The related-work argument and uncertainty-aware novelty positioning remain stable. Publication updates for existing works, including LiDARCrafter, do not constitute new research comparisons.

P1.justification: Changes include limited copyediting and notation cleanup, author and affiliation updates, acknowledgments, and a new quantitative appendix section with subsequent section renumbering. The existing narrative and main section organization are largely retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 9–11, relocates Table 4, and adjusts surrounding layout. It corrects best-score highlighting in Tables 2 and 7 and clarifies Table 7's parallel-branch indicators. All seven figures are retained, including the appendix examples.

improvement.justification: The KITTI-360 benchmark and uncertainty-region ablations strengthen validation of the existing design, particularly its sensitivity to region size and segmentor choice. The rotation-error correction and improved table highlighting also increase clarity. These are useful, focused gains; the central method, original findings, and stated limitations remain unchanged.
